game.name: Battlestations : Pacific (USA)(Beta)(2009-03-12)
game.desc: Battlestations: Pacific is an action-strategy game for Xbox 360 that plunges the player into the heart of the Pacific campaigns, either on the American or Japanese side. In command of ships or planes, the player can choose to respect or change the outcome of the Second World War. Battlestations: Pacific includes 28 main battles, 100 units, five new multiplayer modes, 8 new maps and new game modes: island capture, skirmish and kamikaze attacks.
